# Federato launches Claims to close loss ratio gaps

August 4, 2026

Federato, the AI-native platform for the full insurance policy lifecycle, has launched Federato Claims, an end-to-end claims management system built on the same technology foundation as its underwriting, policy administration and billing tools.

Federato Claims is designed to give carriers real-time visibility into the stage of the policy lifecycle they have traditionally understood least well. The system captures coverage decisions, reserve movements and adjuster reasoning as structured data while a claim remains open, then channels that information back into underwriting, pricing and product development rather than waiting until after a case is closed.
